title: Platinum Reserve Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document explains how holding an eligible Rho-Bank Business Rewards Card increases the APY on a Platinum Reserve Account by fixed additive percentage points: +0.25% (Silver), +0.5% (Gold), +0.8% (Platinum). It covers how/when bonuses adjust daily accruals, how to verify the displayed APY, eligibility maintenance rules (active/in-good-standing, same business entity), and what happens on upgrades/downgrades or closure effective dates.
